newsitem.title: UK: European feeds mixed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: European feeds mixed in quiet trading.

text.p: Lower Chicago futures and a strong dollar kept the lid on the European meals market during Monday.
This morning sellers were offering South American soymeal pellets between $1 up and $1 down following Friday's lower Chicago soymeal futures close.
"As usual it's been a quiet Monday," said one trader.
However, some business was reported with special quality Argentine soy pellets fetching $289 a tonne afloat on the Boreas, eta first week in January 1997.
South American sun pellets traded at $154 and $155 a tonne afloat of the Linda Oldendrof.
On the lower Rhine rapemeal fetched 30.50 marks a 100 kilos ex-mill for December delivery.
